ranking.observableOutcome: The cyan upright open portal reads as one substantial, intentionally built ring supported by two stable navy masses. Rim, outer structure, blue ornament housings and support connections have clear volume and coherent construction. Improve forms/proportions/topology freely within the functional and registered envelope; no source part-count fidelity requirement.

Cyan/blue remain the focus against navy supports, with warm gold or warm neutral structural accents where useful. Rounded bevels and broad soft highlight rolloff give the warm cartoon reference feel, with controlled saturation and visible lower-face detail. All facings use coherent native materials and lighting without preferred horizontal illumination or directional ground shadow.

At logical and phone scale the ring, empty opening, structure and supports remain distinct in N/S; E/W read as purposeful physical edge views with useful thickness. Motion is a smooth 12-frame pulse/circulation, loop closure is visually continuous, and supports stay stable. No broken/tangent-looking joins, z-fighting, black dead patches, clipped ornaments, halos or unreadable tiny decoration on light/gray/dark.

dimensions.shapeVolume: Reward meaningful native modeling improvements; retain upright open ring identity and finite support role. Do not demand target outline pixel matching.
dimensions.color: Maintain cyan/blue/navy hierarchy; target gold can be secondary craft accent, with root accepting palette interpretation.
dimensions.lightingHighlights: Soft shaped native highlights, readable lower faces and consistent volume across four views; not literal frozen target streaks.
dimensions.materialDetail: Clean beveled construction and restrained faceting/detail, visible at intended size; avoid dense microtexture or glossy photographic reflections.
dimensions.artifactFreeReadability: Every required frame/facing and actual playback inspected; N/S aperture remains open, E/W profile remains coherent, alpha clean on three backgrounds.

nonRequirements: Exact target silhouette, part count, gem count, torus topology or painted streaks
Invented modular joins, repeated seam or ship passing through the opening
Extra entry/enter clips or any of the 13 marked 2D effects
Unseen-view aesthetics inferred literally from the one-view target
approvalRule: No candidate exists. Later approval requires visibly improved native exports against root-frozen criteria plus all required technical and visual evidence. Missing evidence remains needs_evidence.
